name: TokenizeThis
description: Conference series connecting institutions, issuers and infrastructure providers working on tokenization and real-world assets. Established by Security Token Market and acquired by RedStone alongside STM.

sources.title: RedStone — Acquisition of STM and TokenizeThis, 21 January 2026

statusNote: RedStone announced its completed acquisition of TokenizeThis and STM on 21 January 2026. The conference continues under RedStone; the separate closing date was not disclosed.
evidenceNote: Official conference website and RedStone acquisition announcement identify the continuing TokenizeThis event series separately from STM’s data business; the transaction is recorded once across both profiles.
